messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "erosive esophagitis"
set: ["erosive esophagitis", "erosive esophagitis in adults and children 1 year of age and older", "40 mg orally once a day for maintenance of healing of erosive esophagitis", "erosive esophagitis caused by acid reflux in adults and children 1 month of age and older", "gastroesophageal reflux disease", "gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)", "damage to the esophagus from stomach acid", "indigestion", "digestion", "symptoms of gastroesophageal reflux disease (gerd) such as heartburn in adults and children 1 year of age and older", "conditions with acid backup from the stomach into the esophagus", "heartburn", "tell your doctor if you have problems with the esophagus, stomach, or intestines", "slow digestion", "oral", "redness"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
